propositions: The close precheck scans all reachable commit messages and calls resolve_ticket_id for every extracted reference, causing ambiguity diagnostics to be printed to stderr even for unrelated historical tickets.
resolve_ticket_id prints three types of ambiguity errors directly to stderr (8-hex, alias, and multi-ticket prefix matches) regardless of context, creating noise when called from history scans.
The precheck gate logic remains correct (ambiguous refs return None and scans complete accurately) but diagnostic output pollutes stderr with unrelated errors.
A quiet parameter added to resolve_ticket_id gates the three stderr print statements, with quiet=True passed only from _referencing_commit_exists history-scan loop.
User-facing commands that explicitly resolve ambiguous ticket IDs retain full diagnostic output when quiet is not set to True.
